questionAnswers.question: You know how sometimes an ordinary girl can be more popular than an exceptional beauty?
questionAnswers.answer: Fancy meals are boring if you eat them every day.

questionAnswers.question: When one professor lectures many students, some will inevitably have trouble keeping up, while others will get too far ahead in their studies.
questionAnswers.answer: Perhaps we should make lectures optional

questionAnswers.question: Such interesting ideas you seem to have, Professor, but tell me this: what would you do if you were given the task of teaching a subject than you yourself did not understand?
questionAnswers.answer: I’d take the time to study the subject before teaching it.

questionAnswers.question: Pretty soon I’ll have eaten everything they have to offer in the dining hall.
questionAnswers.answer: You should just enjoy what you’ve got

questionAnswers.question: Um. Sorry, but you should probably just skip me.
questionAnswers.answer: You just did.

questionAnswers.question: I am an avid arms collector.
questionAnswers.answer: Ask a blacksmith to teach you how to craft your own.

questionAnswers.question: When I take a lecture I’m not interested in, I get so...sleepy.
questionAnswers.answer: No need to fight it. You can’t help it.

questionAnswers.question: I am having a question.
questionAnswers.answer: Try studying the movements of others for improvement.

questionAnswers.question: Lectures about strategy or reason require so much focus, I end up absolutely famished!
questionAnswers.answer: Bring along a snack, just in case.

questionAnswers.question: I’m...kind of terrified to walk the monastery grounds at night.
questionAnswers.answer: Think of it as training for night marches.

questionAnswers.question: I enjoy a good ghost story, but I’ve never seen a ghost in real life.
questionAnswers.answer: Maybe you need a ritual to summon one.

questionAnswers.question: Art has never been my forte.
questionAnswers.answer: Don’t worry about the end result. Just keep practicing.

questionAnswers.question: Magic is not my forte.
questionAnswers.answer: Knowing magic will make you a stronger swordsman.

questionAnswers.question: Though I have served His Highness for four years, he has eluded my every attempt to learn his favorite foods.
questionAnswers.answer: Maybe he just likes everything.

questionAnswers.question: I’ve been trying to win the heart of this girl, but none of the fancy gifts or sweet things I tell her have worked.
questionAnswers.answer: Stay away for a while so she starts to miss you.

questionAnswers.question: No matter the weapon, it cannot be wielded properly without ample strength and stamina, regardless of the skills one may possess.
questionAnswers.answer: Try focusing on one skill at a time, at least for a while.

questionAnswers.question: That was a fascinating lecture, but now my brain is fried.
questionAnswers.answer: Try going for a stroll around the monastery.

questionAnswers.question: There’s so much to do and never enough time in which to do it.
questionAnswers.answer: Sleeping when you’re tired is best for you.

questionAnswers.question: The ladies have been giving me the cold shoulder, of late, I believe it is because they are intimidated by my noble presence.
questionAnswers.answer: Sounds like it’s their problem, not yours.

questionAnswers.question: I just wanna eat meat and fish, but everyone in the dining hall says I gotta eat vegetables too!
questionAnswers.answer: Eating vegetables will help your muscles grow.

questionAnswers.question: I don’t care about being pretty or anything, but it bothers me that some people don’t even realize I’m a girl.
questionAnswers.answer: They’re wrong, pay them no mind

questionAnswers.question: Um, excuse me… Can you help me?
questionAnswers.answer: You might be right. You should be careful.

questionAnswers.question: I hate cleaning my room.
questionAnswers.answer: Ask somebody who’s good at cleaning.

questionAnswers.question: I’m not very good at sharing my opinion.
questionAnswers.answer: They’ll appreciate your opinion. Let yourself be heard.

questionAnswers.question: When I ask them to take part in my experiments, even the most industrious students run away from me.
questionAnswers.answer: Make the "experiment" a "job" and pay them handsomely.

questionAnswers.question: Some people hate spiders or centipedes, but they have no strong feelings towards flies or crickets.
questionAnswers.answer: They may all be bugs, but they’re such different species.

questionAnswers.question: Hey. Maybe you can answer a question I’ve had for a while now…
questionAnswers.answer: Men have unrealistic expectations

questionAnswers.question: As a member of the knights, I sometimes travel by ship for my missions.
questionAnswers.answer: Medicine and magic should help

questionAnswers.question: I want to be able to talk to males and make friends with them, but my brother always causes such a fuss when I do.
questionAnswers.answer: Do it when he’s not looking.

questionAnswers.question: One of your students keeps challenging me to fight him, but he has no idea how to wield a sword.
questionAnswers.answer: Drop a hint that he needs a new training partner.

questionAnswers.question: I'm real happy here, but there's somebody who has up and decided to take pity on me.
questionAnswers.answer: Show them how happy you are working here.

questionAnswers.question: Fodlan has been around for a really long time.
questionAnswers.answer: Investigate local folklore from different regions

questionAnswers.question: A friend of mine's deep in debt, but every time he gets his hands on some money, he ends up giving it to someone he thinks needs it more.
questionAnswers.answer: Why not split the money in half?

questionAnswers.question: Classrooms are so noisy.
questionAnswers.answer: Cover your ears then.

questionAnswers.question: I hope you will indulge me with a candid reply, Professor, so I can have a good laugh.
questionAnswers.answer: Only an official title.

questionAnswers.question: Whenever I send money or food to my mother, she insists she doesn't need any of it.
questionAnswers.answer: Deliver them personally

questionAnswers.question: I heard rumors about ghosts roaming the monastery….
questionAnswers.answer: Let’s bring more candles to the halls to brighten things up.

questionAnswers.question: People call Captain Jeralt the Blade Breaker.
questionAnswers.answer: The Executioner

questionAnswers.question: I prefer to use stealth tactics to assassinate my foes on the battlefield, but you take a different approach.
questionAnswers.answer: Those tactics don’t give the enemy a chance to surrender.

questionAnswers.question: The weak-willed care little for how they are governed, but lady Edelgard wishes to open their eyes.
questionAnswers.answer: The only way to help them is to educate them.

questionAnswers.question: As I am fighting more, my arrows are decreasing in quality.
questionAnswers.answer: New bowstrings could help you shoot with more force.

questionAnswers.question: I sometimes find books written in languages I’ve never seen before.
questionAnswers.answer: Piece things together using linguistic clues.

questionAnswers.question: I want to knit an animal doll for someone, but I’m not sure what kind to make.
questionAnswers.answer: Why not make one of each?

questionAnswers.question: Hey, Professor! I think I’m ready…
questionAnswers.answer: You actually have one, but it’s too scary to say out loud.

questionAnswers.question: The anniversary of Jeralt’s death is coming up.
questionAnswers.answer: The best bottle of booze you can find.

questionAnswers.question: I’ve had this sword for a long time.
questionAnswers.answer: Get the new weapon. Give yourself time to train with it.

questionAnswers.question: Death is an inevitable result of military conflict.
questionAnswers.answer: Adopt new tactics that increase survivability.

questionAnswers.question: I know this is highly unlikely, but on the off chance that Rhea surrenders to my terms, what should I do?
questionAnswers.answer: Strip her of her power so she can’t interfere in politics.

questionAnswers.question: All this savagery, day after day, is depressing.
questionAnswers.answer: Why don’t you ask a girl out?

questionAnswers.question: Some of the children were admiring a painting of mine.
questionAnswers.answer: Woodland creatures.

questionAnswers.question: I haven’t been able to see my brother and sister lately, so I’m sending them gifts instead.
questionAnswers.answer: Maybe you should send him some books.

questionAnswers.question: Songs are so powerless, Professor.
questionAnswers.answer: If we can achieve peace, those songs won’t be powerless.

questionAnswers.question: I think alcohol consumption increases as we continue to fight, day after day after day after…
questionAnswers.answer: Focus on your own intake. I'll worry about everyone else.

questionAnswers.question: When I do nothing but fight, my spirits falter and I lose the will to keep things tidy.
questionAnswers.answer: Take a short break to do something that raises your spirits.

questionAnswers.question: Fishing is what truly calms me, but it is time-consuming.
questionAnswers.answer: Write a story about someone fishing

questionAnswers.question: I don’t think there’s much difference between Almyra and Fodlan.
questionAnswers.answer: It’s prejudice towards unknown places, nothing more.

questionAnswers.question: I have a tactical question, Professor.
questionAnswers.answer: Push forward. Punch a hold in their formation.

questionAnswers.question: Just thinking about how, even now, someone out there is fighting for something, I just can’t seem to sit still, even during my breaks.
questionAnswers.answer: You could assist with my daily tasks, if you’d like

questionAnswers.question: Seeing the cathedral in such a run-down state makes me feel so sorry for the goddess…
questionAnswers.answer: Let’s plant flowers to make it more colorful

questionAnswers.question: Soon a day will come when we must all part ways.
questionAnswers.answer: The goddess will always protect everyone.

questionAnswers.question: Those from northern Faerghus are used to the frigid cold.
questionAnswers.answer: Cooling off in a nearby river is always a good option.

questionAnswers.question: Whenever I visit home, my brother yammers on and on about all the things I'm doing wrong.
questionAnswers.answer: Yammer back at him! See how he likes it!

questionAnswers.question: I had to leave my grandpa in charge of taking care of my little sis while I'm away.
questionAnswers.answer: A tough-looking hat.

questionAnswers.question: Times are hard...
questionAnswers.answer: Maybe the cart will open back up if the war ends.

questionAnswers.question: Considering the current situation and the forces at our command, we will need to rely on mercenaries,
questionAnswers.answer: Mercenary or not, some people will betray your trust

questionAnswers.question: I have always been confident in my exceptional skill, but... lately I will admit I have experienced some minor doubts.
questionAnswers.answer: Remember all you've done. Trust that you've been useful.

questionAnswers.question: I desperately want to travel to some of the places my mother and I spent time in, but I'm not really allowed to leave the monastery walls for such things.
questionAnswers.answer: Close your eyes and pretend she is with you.

questionAnswers.question: I've been thinking it would be nice to throw a big feast for everyone, but we're lacking in surplus supplies.
questionAnswers.answer: Catch some fish from the river

questionAnswers.question: Soldiers have been unhappy with the food lately, and the complaints have been bad for morale.
questionAnswers.answer: Maybe we should hold cooking classes

questionAnswers.question: A town I've done business in before has been deeply affected by the war.
questionAnswers.answer: Give it away with a deal for them to repay later.

questionAnswers.question: I consider it my duty to gift the world with innovations in magic, but my designs rarely have utility in battle.
questionAnswers.answer: Practice is the path to improvement. Keep experimenting.

questionAnswers.question: Fighting doesn't usually wear me out, but five years is a real long time.
questionAnswers.answer: Agreed

questionAnswers.question: I like to wake at dawn and sleep at dusk, but being in an army breaks my routine.
questionAnswers.answer: Pace yourself the best you can

questionAnswers.question: It feels odd to be asking you questions as though I were your student, but I'm wondering...
questionAnswers.answer: Impartially analyze the strength of both sides

questionAnswers.question: Let me just ask you straight.
questionAnswers.answer: The will to fight for those who can’t protect themselves.

questionAnswers.question: I’ve looked at the notes in this box before, and it seems like everyone’s always worried and complaining about stuff!
questionAnswers.answer: Worry often leads to growth

questionAnswers.question: Meat and vegetables are both delicious, but some people complain about not liking one or the other.
questionAnswers.answer: A well-prepared meal should be enjoyed by all

questionAnswers.question: I've never been very good at arithmetic, but I can see how it would be a great skill to have when negotiating with merchants.
questionAnswers.answer: Ask a friend to instruct you

questionAnswers.question: I wonder if I'll ever find a partner who understands I don't mean any harm when I flirt with others.
questionAnswers.answer: You're bound to meet someone open-minded someday

questionAnswers.question: I don't like interfering in squabbles between noble brats, but the parents complain if I don't.
questionAnswers.answer: It could be entertaining to make the parents fight instead.

questionAnswers.question: I often hear ridiculous rumors about ghosts appearing in the monastery.
questionAnswers.answer: You have nothing to worry about. There are no ghosts.

questionAnswers.question: I typically decorate with red roses when I host a tea party but lately I am considering the virtues of variety.
questionAnswers.answer: White lilies are pleasant and calming.

questionAnswers.question: I have some experience painting landscapes, and now I’d like to try my hand at a portraiture.
questionAnswers.answer: Manuela would be open to modeling for you.

questionAnswers.question: I’m trying to read any book about reason I can get my hands on, but now and again, I’ll come across one that’s written in a foreign language.
questionAnswers.answer: You should start by studying the language.

questionAnswers.question: When I was in the greenhouse earlier, a female student fled from me as if in terror.
questionAnswers.answer: Perhaps you unintentionally scowled at her

questionAnswers.question: I’ve slept almost everywhere in the monastery, but lately I’ve been wanting to try sleeping outdoors.
questionAnswers.answer: A courtyard full of blooming flowers.

questionAnswers.question: Nothing surpasses the Hraesvelg Treatise on War as a general study on strategy, but what book best covers local tactics?
questionAnswers.answer: Try reading Cichol’s General Treatise on Mercenaries.

questionAnswers.question: My fellow students have called me dour.
questionAnswers.answer: It can help settle prebattle nerves

questionAnswers.question: If you feel overwhelmed by teaching, just ask me for help.
questionAnswers.answer: I’ll let you know if I have any concerns.

questionAnswers.question: Despite my appearance, I have long wished to be a Pegasus Knight that I may indulge in the lofty view.
questionAnswers.answer: Because heights make you uneasy.

questionAnswers.question: I'm not good at talking to others.
questionAnswers.answer: Try pretending the person you're talking to is a horse.

questionAnswers.question: I am occasionally asked to attend tea parties, but in truth, I do not care for hot beverages.
questionAnswers.answer: You should just be honest with your host.

questionAnswers.question: When I get into a Rhythm while cleaning, I always end up singing a song that I make up on the spot.
questionAnswers.answer: I bet people really enjoy your songs

questionAnswers.question: I found a wonderful painting at a shop in town.
questionAnswers.answer: You should show it to Sylvain.

questionAnswers.question: I am an only child.
questionAnswers.answer: Relax. You can think it over before you graduate.

questionAnswers.question: I have always despised the heat, even as a child.
questionAnswers.answer: Look for clothing and armor which breathe better.

questionAnswers.question: There are many citizens of the Empire who are currently in despair.
questionAnswers.answer: You would do well as a ruler, Ferdinand.

questionAnswers.question: It's my turn to clean, but I'm feeling under the weather.
questionAnswers.answer: Mercedes might be willing to help.

questionAnswers.question: What can I do to ensure than an independently-minded young woman does not fall into harm's way?
questionAnswers.answer: Keep an eye on her from a distance.

questionAnswers.question: Life would be so much easier if no one had to talk face-to-face.
questionAnswers.answer: Occasional human interaction is good for you.

questionAnswers.question: You can always put on more clothing when it's cold, but you can only remove so many layers in the heat.
questionAnswers.answer: Focus on reading to occupy your mind.

questionAnswers.question: I am always looking to assist His Highness, but sometimes I find myself at a loss.
questionAnswers.answer: Guard him with your life.

questionAnswers.question: There's a new place in town I hear has some really tasty food.
questionAnswers.answer: I would be happy to join you

questionAnswers.question: Song and dance live on in our memories, but there's no real record of them.
questionAnswers.answer: I'm sure you'll live on in someone's heart.

questionAnswers.question: Whenever I go for a walk, I get this strange feeling that someone is watching me.
questionAnswers.answer: The goddess is watching from on high

questionAnswers.question: I often overhear people commenting about how strange I am.
questionAnswers.answer: Just follow your own path and don't worry about them.

questionAnswers.question: The library is a place I favor, but I am having a problem.
questionAnswers.answer: You should add to the Traveler’s Journal

questionAnswers.question: Being a bit older than everyone else, I want the others to rely on me like an older sister.
questionAnswers.answer: Don't worry, you already are.

questionAnswers.question: I usually enjoy sweets, but the traditional cakes from Enbarr are a bit much for my taste.
questionAnswers.answer: Who cares traditions are meant to be broken.

questionAnswers.question: It's been a turbulent year.
questionAnswers.answer: Steel yourself by spending some quiet time alone.

questionAnswers.question: There is a person with whom I do not get along.
questionAnswers.answer: Try treating them like you would a friend.

questionAnswers.question: You know, I don't even care when people say I'm short.
questionAnswers.answer: Getting plenty of sleep might help

questionAnswers.question: I am trying to settle on a gift for a certain young lady who has experienced tough times as of late.
questionAnswers.answer: An academic textbook

questionAnswers.question: I want to be able to enjoy my hobbies, but there's not enough time when I have to wait for everyone to go to bed and clear out of the common areas.
questionAnswers.answer: I'm so sorry. That sounds like an impossible situation.

questionAnswers.question: Even if I find love, I won't be able to live without money.
questionAnswers.answer: Love and money aren’t mutually exclusive. Strive for both.

questionAnswers.question: Everyone treats me like a child.
questionAnswers.answer: You shouldn't feel pressured to act older than you are.

questionAnswers.question: (There's just a drawing of what looks like a student throwing trash on the ground.)
questionAnswers.answer: Let's add trash bins around the monastery.

questionAnswers.question: I'd like to borrow a book from the library, but there are so many to choose from that I can't decide.
questionAnswers.answer: A History of the Founding of Faerghus

questionAnswers.question: I have as many worries as anyone else, but I must always feign dauntlessness.
questionAnswers.answer: Find time to relax every now and then

questionAnswers.question: Classroom learning isn't enough to become a strong knight!
questionAnswers.answer: Dimitri would be a good resource.

questionAnswers.question: Flayn is an interesting young lady, but keep your distance.
questionAnswers.answer: A hedge between keeps friendships green.

questionAnswers.question: If I told you I was searching for someone who might like to share a cup of tea with an elegant noble, whose name would come to mind?
questionAnswers.answer: Ferdinand would be good company

questionAnswers.question: Lately I feel myself growing tired and out of practice.
questionAnswers.answer: What about Dorothea?

questionAnswers.question: Words cannot express my disgust with the students here.
questionAnswers.answer: You should spar with them

questionAnswers.question: There are as many men in this world as stars in the sky, but you meet so few good men during your time on this planet.
questionAnswers.answer: Man or no man, lots of people care about you.

questionAnswers.question: I have great love for the sea, but Garreg Mach has too much distance from it.
questionAnswers.answer: You should visit a sea to the south

questionAnswers.question: I feel like the tough fighters who become legends mostly use swords and lances.
questionAnswers.answer: You should fight with the weapon the best suits you

questionAnswers.question: I try to hold back when swinging a weapon, but sometimes I misjudge my own strength.
questionAnswers.answer: Take care to repair weapons in between training sessions.

questionAnswers.question: It’s standard practice for a general not to stand on the front lines.
questionAnswers.answer: The “standard practice” isn’t always the best practice.

questionAnswers.question: I see it all the time.
questionAnswers.answer: That sounds like the logic of a schemer

questionAnswers.question: There’s someone whose Crest I wish to study.
questionAnswers.answer: Nothing beats sincerity

questionAnswers.question: I’m not good at cleaning up.
questionAnswers.answer: Cleaning is easy when you have a plan of attack

questionAnswers.question: A professor’s job seems so repetitive.
questionAnswers.answer: I’m too busy to be bored

questionAnswers.question: I wish to make new friends, but my brother always interferes.
questionAnswers.answer: I’ll persuade him to stop

questionAnswers.question: There’s someone I just can’t seem to beat.
questionAnswers.answer: ”Quick and easy” never works

questionAnswers.question: (There’s just a drawing of what looks like a broken vase.)
questionAnswers.answer: If you broke a vase, you should apologize to the owner.

questionAnswers.question: I’m supposed to write a letter to my brother to let him know how I’m doing.
questionAnswers.answer: Why not tell him about your friends?

questionAnswers.question: The tea here does absolutely nothing for me.
questionAnswers.answer: Lorenz would be a good source.

questionAnswers.question: I am more than capable of protecting myself from ruffians, but those around me tend to worry, and so I am often denied the pleasure of a private stroll.
questionAnswers.answer: You're too important, so I'm afraid it can't be helped.

questionAnswers.question: I want to make somebody change his boorish behavior, but he doesn’t seem to care no matter how much I urge him to reconsider his actions.
questionAnswers.answer: It’s probably time for your professor to step in.

questionAnswers.question: I’m hesitant to invite a girl to my room in the middle of the night with You Know Who living right next door.
questionAnswers.answer: Maybe I’ll rethink the room assignments.

questionAnswers.question: I want to get better at cooking, but I don’t know where to start.
questionAnswers.answer: You should cook with Ashe

questionAnswers.question: I've reunited with my daughter after years of being apart, but I'm the one who left her in the first place.
questionAnswers.answer: Just love her and treat her with kindness.

questionAnswers.question: When I see the students enthusiastically eating together in the dining hall, I sometimes wish to join them.
questionAnswers.answer: I'm sure the students would be happy to share a meal.

questionAnswers.question: Everyone seems to believe I only ever think about the buying and selling of things, but I'm very multifaceted!
questionAnswers.answer: Worrying is a waste of time, and time is money!

questionAnswers.question: The only physicians willing to work underground are ones who charge exorbitant amounts for their services.
questionAnswers.answer: Ask the church for help

questionAnswers.question: All my problems boil down to not having enough gold.
questionAnswers.answer: Next time you've got gold, I'll help you decide.

questionAnswers.question: So I write my problems here, and you fix them for me?
questionAnswers.answer: You could at least write me a good joke

questionAnswers.question: I could say I have no concerns, but of course I would be lying.
questionAnswers.answer: That may actually be too much, even for you.

questionAnswers.question: Growing out my hair was not intentional.
questionAnswers.answer: It looks good on you.

questionAnswers.question: What’s the difference between killing someone and calling for their death instead?
questionAnswers.answer: Like all things, it’s about context and perspective.

questionAnswers.question: I fear that I will not be able to achieve my dream within my lifetime.
questionAnswers.answer: It will be easy after we rebuild the Officer's Academy.

questionAnswers.question: I hope to improve my riding skills before our next battle.
questionAnswers.answer: Start by befriending the horse you’ll be riding.

questionAnswers.question: People used to believe the goddess once fell here from the Blue Sea Star, but according to astronomical research, the light from that star takes millions of years to reach us.
questionAnswers.answer: Lies about the goddess abound.

questionAnswers.question: No joke, I lost the book where I write all my puns.
questionAnswers.answer: You’re probably just not searching the write places.

questionAnswers.question: I understand the risk of fighting on the front lines, but I simply must be out there to lead my troops.
questionAnswers.answer: It’s said that the best defense is a good offense.

questionAnswers.question: My dream of becoming a proper knight still feels so far off.
questionAnswers.answer: Be honest and stick to your convictions

questionAnswers.question: Every day is filled with the harshness of war.
questionAnswers.answer: Everyone finds solace in different ways.

questionAnswers.question: All we do is battle.
questionAnswers.answer: Good idea, I’ll see what I can do.

questionAnswers.question: Garreg Mach is surrounded by the abundance of nature, but securing provisions during times of warring can still be difficult.
questionAnswers.answer: Yes, this place is quite different than Brigid.

questionAnswers.question: Nobles must never lose their composure.
questionAnswers.answer: In battle, survival is all that matters.

questionAnswers.question: I thought being a noble meant having some sway in life.
questionAnswers.answer: One day everyone will listen to you...and leave you alone.

questionAnswers.question: I appreciate ruined buildings.
questionAnswers.answer: They remind us that life is impermanent as well.

questionAnswers.question: What are all these knight lovers talking about when they go on and on about chivalry?
questionAnswers.answer: They’re referring to strength and courage.

questionAnswers.question: I have a burning ambition, but making it come true would mean betraying my parent’s wishes.
questionAnswers.answer: Nothing will change unless you are honest with them.

questionAnswers.question: After the war, there will be fewer opportunities to fight.
questionAnswers.answer: Strive to become the best in all of Fodlan.

questionAnswers.question: Everyone who hears the songs I make up laughs and says they’re funny, but they’re not supposed to be humorous!
questionAnswers.answer: Don’t fret. They’re great lyrics that are unforgettable.

questionAnswers.question: I want to be helpful, but I lack the self-confidence to do so.
questionAnswers.answer: You should stay, you’re more helpful than you realize.

questionAnswers.question: Sometimes I make really, really big mistakes.
questionAnswers.answer: Just stay calm and be aware of your surroundings.

questionAnswers.question: In the past, I would nearly pass out if I got splattered by an enemy’s blood.
questionAnswers.answer: It’s natural to feel repelled by the horrors of war.

questionAnswers.question: I have concerns about allowing a young woman still on the cusp of adulthood to spend time alone with members of the opposite sex.
questionAnswers.answer: Try to prevent it as much as you can.

questionAnswers.question: My dear friend has been behaving strangely.
questionAnswers.answer: You should seek out an expert opinion, just to be safe.

questionAnswers.question: I really start craving sweets when I am tired or stressed out.
questionAnswers.answer: Check the library for a simple, traditional recipe.

questionAnswers.question: I wonder if there will be a day when both the monastery and Faerghus are restored to their former glory.
questionAnswers.answer: That day will come. We'll make sure of it.

questionAnswers.question: Isn't there a way to turn withered, barren land into soil that is rich and abundant with crops?
questionAnswers.answer: Check the library for books on unique farming techniques.

questionAnswers.question: In an attempt to clean my room, I tried to throw out the things I no longer need, but I can't bring myself to do it.
questionAnswers.answer: Meeting new people helps make new memories

questionAnswers.question: I've recently begun to think that ghosts may not exist.
questionAnswers.answer: It could have been some kind of magic.

questionAnswers.question: How can I convince someone who is working himself sick to take a break?
questionAnswers.answer: Invite him to sit down to a relaxing meal

questionAnswers.question: People always say that my muscles are huge, but I'm still not satisfied!
questionAnswers.answer: Huge muscles are a symbol of strength.

questionAnswers.question: I used to think it foolish to cover one's face in battle with a mask or helmet, but it actually may not be that bad.
questionAnswers.answer: Never turn a blind eye to your own actions.

questionAnswers.question: I trip all the time, but what if I trip on the battlefield?
questionAnswers.answer: Focus on what you'll do if the enemy trips instead.

questionAnswers.question: My hair's longer than it used to be.
questionAnswers.answer: It looks good long.

questionAnswers.question: I'm weary from this ceaseless fighting.
questionAnswers.answer: You will one day, I'm sure of it.

questionAnswers.question: Someone I care about has been working so hard that I'm worried they might collapse from exhaustion.
questionAnswers.answer: A nice meal shows support and provides a chance to relax.

questionAnswers.question: Perhaps it is because I am operating with half my normal vision now, but desk work strains my eye terribly.
questionAnswers.answer: Have someone acquire eye drops for you.

questionAnswers.question: I don't have time to leisurely wait for the future.
questionAnswers.answer: The steady approach is actually the fastest, in the end.

questionAnswers.question: I am interested in cooking, but I can't seem to get any better at it.
questionAnswers.answer: Keep practicing and you'll get the hang of it.

questionAnswers.question: I'm so busy working that I don't have time to train.
questionAnswers.answer: Just do what you can and try your best.

questionAnswers.question: I hate having to be sneaky and stay quiet when an enemy is in my line of sight.
questionAnswers.answer: You'll get better at it if you train.

questionAnswers.question: We've been without Lady Rhea for more than five years.
questionAnswers.answer: Don't worry. We will find her and rescue her.

questionAnswers.question: If someone is having trouble falling asleep, you could sing them a lullaby, but you can't really do that for yourself.
questionAnswers.answer: If you exercise before bed, that's sure to tire you out.

questionAnswers.question: I wrote a letter to my wife back home, but now I can't bring myself to send it.
questionAnswers.answer: I'm sure hearing from you would make her happy.

questionAnswers.question: Some structures on the battlefield are centuries old.
questionAnswers.answer: You can immortalize them in your art.

questionAnswers.question: I think a change of pace is necessary every so often.
questionAnswers.answer: You should sample food at various restaurants

questionAnswers.question: A prominent noble ought to possess a few quality pieces of art.
questionAnswers.answer: A magnificent landscape

questionAnswers.question: I fear falling asleep at night.
questionAnswers.answer: We won't allow that to happen.

questionAnswers.question: Some people want to make a difference by fighting on the front lines, but there are those of us who want to provide support from the back.
questionAnswers.answer: As long as everyone does their part, I'm happy.

questionAnswers.question: I'm writing a letter to my little sis, and I want to send her a present, but I never know what to send.
questionAnswers.answer: Send her some tasty treats.

questionAnswers.question: Sometimes I think that living like I do, single but surrounded by talented youths, might not be such a lonely life after all.
questionAnswers.answer: If you do get lonely, I can lend you an ear.

questionAnswers.question: A subordinate is down because they failed a recon mission.
questionAnswers.answer: Say that only the living can learn from their mistakes.

questionAnswers.question: I have been searching for an ideal wife with whom to start a family for years now.
questionAnswers.answer: After the war, such pursuits will be much easier.

questionAnswers.question: I've always hated exercising and avoided training, but now I'm afraid that I may be holding everyone back.
questionAnswers.answer: You can boost their morale with a delicious meal.

questionAnswers.question: I've lived in the slums for a long time, and I saw how the people there suffered from poverty and the ravages of war.
questionAnswers.answer: Strive to save Fodlan from the ground up.

questionAnswers.question: I'd like to have a duel with you where we're both giving it our all, but I suspect if we crossed blades without holding anything back, one of us would end up dead.
questionAnswers.answer: Let's just try to survive this war for now.

questionAnswers.question: I am composing a record of our battles, for posterity's sake.
questionAnswers.answer: The battle in the underground chamber.

questionAnswers.question: It is, of course, necessary to keep one's quarters nice and tidy.
questionAnswers.answer: A messy battlefield helps one appreciate a clean room.

questionAnswers.question: My friend's birthday is coming up, and I want to make her a gift.
questionAnswers.answer: I'm sure she'd be happy to get either one.

questionAnswers.question: Animals have never been fond of me.
questionAnswers.answer: If it gives you more confidence, hide behind a helmet

questionAnswers.question: If there were three villages with no watering holes, and one well was dug along the border between the villages, what do you think would become of the people there?
questionAnswers.answer: A war would likely start over dominion of the well.

questionAnswers.question: How can I create a world where everyone is on equal footing, regardless of their place of birth, their bloodline, or whether they have a Crest?
questionAnswers.answer: Lead by example, and show the world what it's capable of

questionAnswers.question: I hate that I couldn't protect Lady Rhea five year ago.
searchAliases: I hate that I couldn't protect Lady Rhea five years ago.
questionAnswers.answer: Keep at it. You're getting stronger all the time.

questionAnswers.question: I have attained great skill at writing this language.
questionAnswers.answer: There's no trick, just keep practicing.

questionAnswers.question: Once, as a boy, I struck my father.
questionAnswers.answer: That's just how life is sometimes.

questionAnswers.question: When I was a child, I feared such trivial things as divine punishment and grudges held by the dead.
questionAnswers.answer: In truth, it's reality that is most frightening.

questionAnswers.question: Fishing is what truly calms me, but it is time-consuming.
questionAnswers.answer: Write a story about fishing.
